title: #625 review: the inherit fix departs from the frozen spec (FR-20 JSON output, FR-22/AC-29 field names)
context: Commit e098b713 fixed the review's inherit finding correctly, but it changed two things the frozen spec pins with no spec.change packet. (1) FR-20 says 'paqad-ai stage settings ... prints them as JSON'; the verb now prints one plain line per stage (src/cli/commands/stage.ts:31 via stageSettingsReport). The lines are regular ('<stage>: effort X, model Y. On its Agent call, ...') and the per-session JSON file is still written, so the values stay usable, but stdout is no longer JSON. (2) FR-22 and AC-29 say the stage-agent row carries 'effort' and 'model'; the schema and recorder now write 'requested_effort' and 'requested_model' (src/stage-evidence/schema.ts:70-71, src/stage-isolation/subagent-completion.ts:118-125). The rename is honest, because the row records what was asked for, not what ran. Everything else checks out: the guardrail fixture is byte-identical to a fresh render from main 1f85100f, and the 61 affected test files (865 tests) pass.
